upload_purpose: Add .torrent files you already have, by hand or from a folder. Each one goes through your filters, like a torrent the crawler finds.
upload_drop_hint: Drop .torrent files anywhere on this page.
upload_limits: Up to {max} files at a time, each at most {size}. Only the file's contents are sent, never its name.
upload_too_many: You chose {n} files, and Lodestar takes at most {max} at a time. Choose fewer, then add the rest.
upload_state_rate_limited_wait: Too many uploads. Retry in {seconds} s
upload_state_unavailable: Lodestar isn't taking uploads now. Retry later
upload_state_failed: Couldn't send. Check the connection, then retry
upload_watch_how: Lodestar looks in this folder every 10 seconds and adds each .torrent file in it, with the same checks as an upload. A file that's still being copied is left until it stops changing.
upload_watch_after: Added files move to added/ inside the folder. The rest move to failed/, with the reason in the name, such as name.held.torrent. To try a failed file again, move it back into the folder.
upload_watch_rule: Don't use Lodestar's data folder, a folder inside it or a folder that holds it: Lodestar never reads one of those.
upload_watch_inside: Off: this folder is Lodestar's data folder or inside it, so Lodestar won't read it. Choose another folder.
upload_watch_holds: Off: Lodestar's data folder is inside this folder, so Lodestar won't read it. Choose another folder.
upload_watch_logs: If files stay in the folder, the log says why the watch is off.
